Commercial Inland Marine Objection Response to Letter of December 21, 2017: 
  
This letter is in response to the objection to filing SERFF Tr Num: QBEC-131306101 which requests the 
following information: 
  
Submit the template with variance. Indicate the variance number on the space provided on the Ratemaking 
Data page. Page 6.B of our filing instructions reads: "Filings requesting a variance must include one Rate 
Template excluding the variance and one Rate Template including the variance. A filing with multiple variances 
must include one Rate Template for each individual variance as well as the combined impact of all variances." 
  
The following is a chart that lists the annual premium trend, loss development factors, annual loss trend, 
and indicated rate change range for the Commercial Inland Marine filing referenced above.

The first line of the chart is a summary of what was originally filed with the California Department of 
Insurance. The objection requested one rate template for each variance as well as the combined impact 
of all variances. Since the loss trend produced an error on the standard exhibit, it is not possible to 
complete the rate template with no variance (see line 2 of the chart). 
  
Line 3 is a summary of variance 8B, Loss Trend Only. 
  
Since the standard exhibits produced an error for the loss trend as noted above, variance 7A (loss 
development factors) and variance 8B (premium trend) were combined with variance 8B (loss trend), to 
calculate the indicated rate change ranges shown in lines 4 and 5, respectively. 
  
The attached files contain the rate templates for scenarios 3-5 above. Scenario 1 was submitted with the 
original filing and scenario 2 cannot be calculated. The file names are numbered according to the 
corresponding scenario. 
  
Please let me know if any further information is needed for your continued review of our filing.
